en.name: Maple syrup, unopened glass
en.summary: An unopened glass bottle of genuine maple syrup keeps 4 years in the cupboard. Glass gives the longest life of any maple syrup container because nothing passes through it. That figure is for the sealed bottle only — once opened, maple syrup is a refrigerated food.
en.pantry: Sealed in glass, in a cool, dark, dry cupboard, genuine maple syrup keeps 4 years. Glass is the reason the number is this long: it is completely impermeable, so neither oxygen nor moisture reaches the syrup and neither flavour nor colour drifts the way it does in plastic or a tin. Keep the bottle upright, out of direct sun and away from the hob — heat darkens syrup and pushes the flavour towards caramel over time. Sugar crystals forming in the bottom of an old bottle are not spoilage.
en.fridge: An unopened glass bottle does not need the fridge. An opened one does, and that is the important half of the answer: real maple syrup is only about two-thirds sugar, which is dilute enough for mould and yeast to grow on the surface, so once the seal is broken it lives in the refrigerator at 4 °C (40 °F) or below with the cap on tight. Pour what you need and put the bottle straight back — the syrup that sits warm in a jug on the breakfast table is the part that spoils.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for unopened maple syrup, and there is no need for one while the bottle is sealed. Freezing is a legitimate way to hold a large quantity for a long time — the syrup goes thick and sluggish rather than solid — but never freeze it in the glass bottle itself, because the liquid expands and glass does not. Decant into a plastic container with headspace if you are going to do it.
en.thawing: If you have frozen decanted syrup, move it to the fridge to soften, then let it come up in a jug of warm water. Do not microwave it in a sealed container.
spoilage: Mould floating on the surface or growing around the neck and cap.
A fermented, winey or yeasty smell instead of a clean caramel one.
Cloudiness or stringy threads running through the syrup.
A bottle that fizzes or pressurises when the cap is loosened.
tips: Keep the unopened bottle upright in a dark cupboard, not on a sunny shelf.
Refrigerate as soon as it is opened; that is when the clock changes.
Warm the bottle in hot water rather than the microwave to loosen thick syrup.
Decant before freezing — glass will crack as the syrup expands.

faq.q: How long does unopened maple syrup keep?
faq.a: 4 years in a sealed glass bottle in a cool dark cupboard.

faq.q: Does maple syrup need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Not while it is sealed. Once opened it must be refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, because real maple syrup is dilute enough to grow surface mould.

faq.q: Is maple syrup still good if it has crystals in it?
faq.a: Yes. Sugar crystallising out of an old bottle is a physical change. Stand the bottle in hot water and stir. Mould or a fermented smell is different, and means it goes.

zh.name: 楓糖漿（玻璃瓶未開封）
zh.summary: 未開封的玻璃瓶裝純楓糖漿放櫥櫃可放 4 年。玻璃是所有楓糖漿容器中期限最長的，因為什麼都穿不過去。但這個數字只屬於「未開封」——一旦打開，楓糖漿就是冷藏食品。
zh.pantry: 玻璃瓶密封、放陰涼避光乾燥的櫥櫃，純楓糖漿可放 4 年。數字之所以這麼長，關鍵就在玻璃：它完全不透氣，氧氣和水氣都到不了糖漿，風味與顏色也不會像塑膠瓶或鐵罐那樣慢慢走位。瓶子請直立放置，避免陽光直射、遠離爐台——高溫會讓糖漿顏色變深，風味一年年往焦糖那邊偏。放久的瓶底結出糖晶，不是壞掉。
zh.fridge: 未開封的玻璃瓶不需要冰。開封後的則一定要，而這才是真正重要的一半：真正的楓糖漿含糖量大約只有三分之二，稀到足以讓表面長霉、長酵母，所以封條一破，它就住進 4 °C 以下的冰箱，瓶蓋要旋緊。要多少倒多少，瓶子隨手冰回去——早餐桌上那壺放到微溫的糖漿，才是會壞掉的那一份。
zh.freezer: 未開封的楓糖漿沒有公布的冷凍期限，密封狀態下也不需要。冷凍確實是長期存放大量糖漿的正當做法（它會變得濃稠遲滯，而不是結成硬塊），但絕對不要連玻璃瓶一起冷凍，因為液體會膨脹、玻璃不會。真的要冷凍，請倒進留有空間的塑膠容器。
zh.thawing: 如果冷凍的是分裝出來的糖漿，先移到冷藏軟化，再連容器泡在溫水裡回溫。不要把密封容器直接微波。
spoilage: 表面浮霉，或瓶口、瓶蓋周圍長霉。
聞起來有發酵味、酒味或酵母味，而不是乾淨的焦糖香。
糖漿變混濁，或出現牽絲狀的懸浮物。
旋開瓶蓋時有氣體衝出或明顯脹氣。
tips: 未開封的瓶子直立放在暗處櫥櫃，不要放在會曬到太陽的層架。
一開封就冷藏，計時方式在那一刻改變。
糖漿變稠就把瓶子泡熱水，不要微波。
要冷凍請先分裝，玻璃瓶會因糖漿膨脹而破裂。

faq.q: 未開封的楓糖漿可以放多久？
faq.a: 玻璃瓶密封放陰涼避光的櫥櫃，可放 4 年。
未開封不用。開封後一定要冷藏在 4 °C 以下，因為真楓糖漿夠稀，表面會長霉。

faq.q: 楓糖漿結晶了還能吃嗎？
faq.a: 可以，那是糖析出的物理變化，把瓶子泡熱水攪一攪就好。長霉或有發酵味則是另一回事，要丟掉。
